name: Top 10 mặt hàng tồn kho lớn nhất
query:
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(b.stock_value) DESC) AS "Sort:Hidden",
    b.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:150",
    i.item_name AS "Item Name::250",
    SUM(b.actual_qty) AS "Total Qty:Float:120",
    SUM(b.stock_value) AS "Total Stock Value:Currency:180"
FROM `tabBin` b
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = b.item_code
GROUP BY b.item_code, i.item_name
ORDER BY SUM(b.actual_qty) DESC
LIMIT 10;
report_name: Top 10 mặt hàng tồn kho lớn nhất
